news.headline: ADB SAFEGATE Officially Opens New Global Headquarters and Factory in Belgium

paragraphs: ADB SAFEGATE supplies airside systems to airports, airlines and air navigation service providers. Airfield hardware includes a runway status light system. Gate-side products include a docking guidance system. Apron management software is presented as a route to safer and faster aircraft turnarounds.

The company groups this work under a strategy that connects airside assets to produce real-time insight for decision making. The stated aims are safety, efficiency and sustainability across the airside. Weather products are framed as a way to reduce risk on the airfield. Alongside equipment the site lists maintenance services offered globally, and training in ICAO countries.

Announcements on the site name air navigation providers, including Austro Control for air traffic control at Vienna Airport. Another states that JetBlue Airways selected the company's docking guidance system for a multi-airport upgrade. The company reports opening a global headquarters and factory in Machelen, Belgium.
